description: Review and update application documentation to match current implementation, humanize the prose, then document and commit the changes.
name: update application documentation

configJson.prompt: Review {application}'s current codebase and every document in docs/. Correct confirmed inaccuracies in API references, architecture docs, and feature documentation. Preserve accurate content and necessary technical detail. Update existing files only; do not create new documentation files.

configJson.args: {application} docs/ - review every Markdown file and make needed prose edits in place. Leave effective prose unchanged. Preserve factual scope, technical detail, commands, and links. Save edits to the existing files; report changed and unchanged files rather than returning rewrites as chat output
{application} docs/ - correct every inaccuracy you confirm against the current codebase. Save corrections in place, preserve accurate passages, and update existing files only
